motivation: Gold/silver relative-value v1-v6 repeatedly produced interesting state structure without a robust executable chain. This protocol switches to a structurally distinct XAUUSD intraday mechanism: return transmission across global trading sessions. A recent 2026 working paper motivates the question but its 2024-2026 sample is not used for development and is not treated as evidence for this project.

source.timestamp_semantics: UTC according to the pinned repository README

retrospective_extension.claim_boundary: This period overlaps the recently published session-decomposition study and other already-inspected gold evidence; it can never count as untouched future OOS.

sessions_utc.note: US ends at 21:00 UTC rather than 24:00 UTC. This is predeclared to avoid broker daily-close/maintenance hours and is not intended as an exact replication of the 2026 paper.

session_return.definition: log(last admitted M15 close / exact session first M15 open)
session_return.same_day_entry_semantics: a source session must be fully complete before its target session begins
session_return.previous_us_to_next_asia: previous admitted trading day's US-liquid return predicts the next admitted trading day's Asia return

state_first.predictor: momentum uses source session return; reversal uses negative source session return
